name: GameHub
description: Installers verified by MD5/SHA from unsigned manifest.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: GameHub’s installer compares an available per-part checksum with retrieved game content and reports mismatches. This is a conditional content-integrity control; metadata authentication and the full distribution policy remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; released artifact behavior may differ.
